definitions: To cause (someone or something) to ascend; to raise (someone or something) to a high position.
High, tall, towering; also, positioned in a high place; high-up, lofty.
Of an aspect of art or nature: causing awe or deep respect due to its beauty or magnificence; awe-inspiring, impressive.

blocks.text: Sublime is the third studio album by American ska punk band Sublime. Produced by Paul Leary and David Kahne, the album was released on July 30, 1996, by MCA Records. It is their first release following the death of singer Bradley Nowell and is the final studio album to feature him.
Sublime, formerly known as Sublime Artist Agency, is a South Korean entertainment and management company founded on April 17, 2015. Based in Seoul, it manages actors, solo musicians, and K-pop idols.
